matching.definition: n50 full autonomous grid windows; same episode; closest temporal progress within 5% episode length; nonoverlapping windows; negative origins without replacement; positives processed in time order; fixed across checkpoints
matching.limitation: Exploratory temporal-progress matching, not visual/state matching or causal ground truth; unmatched positives excluded; adjacent windows remain correlated; episode bootstrap; no natural-prevalence AP on 1:1 matched set
